scope: Scalar bitvector/state-model obligations only. No full original function or x86 semantics proof; no generated game C++.

obligations.name: base
obligations.meaning: Zero initial index and offset establish relation.

obligations.name: step_with_uint_bound
obligations.meaning: i<n, both uint32, rules out wrap on this increment.

obligations.name: same_memory_read
obligations.meaning: Same effective address in flat read-only memory model. Does not prove C++ pointer validity.

obligations.name: missing_bound
obligations.meaning: Counterexample if the increment may occur at UINT_MAX.

obligations.name: wrong_stride
obligations.meaning: A stride of 16 is not equivalent to index increment for 8-byte elements.

obligations.name: capacity_branch_under_invariant
obligations.meaning: Only under count<=capacity can the out-of-capacity path be excluded.

obligations.name: capacity_branch_without_invariant
obligations.meaning: A valid search bound alone does not justify bypassing TArrayList fallback.

obligations.name: invariant_preserved_by_increment_in_capacity
obligations.meaning: Already-reserved append preserves count<=capacity in uint32 model.

obligations.name: invariant_preserved_by_remove
obligations.meaning: Valid removal decreases count without unsigned wrap.

obligations.name: capacity_growth_wrap_counterexample
obligations.meaning: Naive preservation by growing an unsigned capacity fails on wrap; actual allocation behavior not modeled.
